i.norm:
Tests for {@link Entities#escape(String)}, which escapes a string using the default settings: base HTML escape mode and UTF-8 character set.

Under these defaults:

  • {@code &} → {@code &}
  • {@code <} → {@code <}
  • {@code >} → {@code >}
  • {@code '} → {@code '} (both text and attribute contexts are assumed)
  • {@code "} → {@code "} (attribute context is assumed)
  • Non-ASCII characters that UTF-8 can encode (Å, å, π, 新, ¾, ©, ») are left as-is because they do not need to be escaped when the output charset supports them.

Input contains: HTML special chars (&, <, >), non-ASCII UTF-8 chars that should pass through unchanged, and quote chars (' and ") that must always be escaped because both text and attribute contexts are assumed.
&, <, > are always escaped; ', " are escaped (combined text+attribute mode); all other characters are encodable in UTF-8 and therefore left unchanged.
